content.title: Is Walmart open on Easter? Holiday hours for April 5
content.text: BusinessWalmart will be open on Easter 2026, which falls on Sunday, April 5.Patti Sapone | NJ.com By Katherine Rodriguez | NJ.comEaster is finally here, but you might still be scrambling to get everything you need to celebrate the holiday. That can be anything from prefilled Easter baskets to the dinner you’re feeding your family tonight for the special day. But because it’s a holiday, it’s not always clear if popular stores, like Walmart, will be open to run some errands. That’s especially true when stores like Costco and Lowe’s will close up shop today. If you need to pick up some last-minute necessities, here’s everything you need to know about Walmart this Easter Sunday. Is Walmart closed on Easter Sunday 2026?No, Walmart is open on Easter this year, just like it was on Good Friday. Its store nationwide will be open from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m. so you still have time to buy any odds and ends you’ve missed. Walmart does not usually close on Easter. However, its stores tend to close on the following holidays: If you need to head over there ASAP, you can find your local Walmart here.What Easter deals can I shop at Walmart today?Walmart is still offering three Easter dinner bundle deals that you can pick up before this evening. Each one comes with ham and several sides.The first Easter dinner bundle for $33 feeds up to eight people, costing you $5 per person. It comes with a spiral-cut, glazed ham, seven sides and a dessert. a 3-4-pound Marketside Natural Juice Boneless Spiral-Cut Brown Sugar Double Glazed Hama one bunch bundle of fresh green whole asparagusa 2-pound bag of fresh baby-cut carrotsa 12-count frozen bag of Green Giant Extra Sweet Corn on The Coba 5-pound bag of fresh whole russet potatoes a 14-ounce Great Value Deluxe Original Cheddar Macaroni & Cheese packagea 12-count of Great Value Large White Eggsa 12-count of Great Value Brown and Serve White Dinner Rolls, 12 ouncea 16-ounce tub of Betty Crocker Rich and Creamy Cream Cheese Frosting, Gluten Freea 13.25-ounce Betty Crocker Delights Super Moist Carrot Cake MixMeanwhile, another similar Easter dinner bundle for $42 with seven sides and a dessert also serves up to eight people but for $6 per person. It comes with similar foods, except the mac & cheese is from Kraft, the dessert is a Marketside Variety Creme Cake, a fresh navel orange and Great Value Sweet Hawaiian Rolls. The larger Easter dinner bundle for $75 serves even more guests. Along with an 8-12-pound Marketside Natural Juice Bone-in Spiral Cut Brown Sugar Double Glazed Ham, Pork, it comes with the following food: Dole Pineapple Slices in 100% Pineapple Juice, 20 oz CanGreat Value Whipped Topping, Dessert and Fruit Topping, 8 oz (Frozen)Great Value Whole Strawberries, 16 oz (Frozen)Great Value Mayonnaise, 30 fl ozFreshness Guaranteed Vanilla Dessert Shells, 5 oz, 6 Count Great Value Brown and Serve White Dinner Rolls, 12 oz, 12 Count Betty Crocker Scalloped Potatoes, Made with Real Cheese, Twin Pack, 8.6 oz. (frozen) Also, if you still need prefilled Easter baskets, you can find them for under $30 at Walmart packed with several goodies.
